_comment: Merge the `hooks` block into the consumer repo's .claude/settings.json. Pairs with .agents/hooks/validate-on-edit.sh (see ../SKILL.md).
_comment_timeout: The hook enforces its own per-command budget (VALIDATE_BUDGET_S, default 3s). The 15s harness timeout here is only a backstop for a wedged docker daemon.
_comment_coverage: PostToolUse Edit|Write does NOT cover files written through the Bash tool (`cat > f.ts`, `sed -i`, code generators). This hook reduces the verify stage; it does not replace it.
